_meta.methodology: Each fact below was sourced via web search from earnings reports, company press releases, or reputable tech/business press, with a source and date attached. Facts without a precise public source are explicitly marked 'approximate' rather than stated as fact. Feature-matrix flags (live sports, 4K, etc.) are compiled from each platform's public plan pages, not from a trained model -- there's no ML here, it's a structured comparison framework, which is the honest way to do this without real usage/review data.
_meta.caveat: Pricing changes frequently (JioHotstar alone changed its pricing in Jan 2026). Treat these as a snapshot, not live data -- a real deployment would need a scheduled re-scrape of each pricing page.
